_comment: ONE/ZERO is a 'replace' blend: result = src*1 + dst*0. The bake WRITES the slick into an empty offscreen target, it does not add to anything. Declared rather than omitted on purpose - omitting the section parses to an OPAQUE BlendMode, and BlendMode.apply() only touches glEnable(BLEND) when opaque-ness CHANGES against a static lastApplied, so an opaque mode here would leave GL's blend enable disagreeing with lastApplied for the rest of the frame (see the LOAD-BEARING note in CustomGlintRenderer above CHROMATIC_MODEL_UV_SCALE). A non-opaque replace keeps that invariant and still writes the slick verbatim.
